completion_decisions: Use the paper Cp and induction fits where Fig.4 samples are unavailable.
Use one-diameter center spacing required by the paper-native dense case.
Use per-run one-core C++ plus 20 concurrent seeds for the fine-grained full-resource mode.
Retain the original 3-by-3 validation: reproduced 2.537997 W and 0.732467 versus paper 2.53 W and 0.73.

paper.authors: Souma Chowdhury and Jie Zhang and Achille Messac and Luciano Castillo
paper.title: Unrestricted Wind Farm Layout Optimization: Investigating Key Factors Influencing the Maximum Power Generation

paper_source_conflicts: No author implementation or exact Fig.4 power samples were located.
Eq.29 printed diameter sums conflict with feasibility of the paper's 18-turbine 7D by 3D case.

scope.claim_boundary: paper-equation academic declared reproduction with original-layout magnitude validation; no author-source or author-exact optimization claim

constraints_and_repair.resolution: bound projection, one-diameter center spacing required by the 18-turbine 7D by 3D case, and Case-2 mean cost

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x,y coordinates and Case-2 rotor diameters

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: all x, all y, then optional diameter variables

initialization.resolution: uniform bounded positions/diameters and zero initial velocities

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: power, efficiency, feasibility, physical FES, timings, hash, five paper repeats and 25 platform seeds

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize effective farm efficiency under geometric and optional cost constraints

paper_native_cases.resolution: Cases 1, 2, Case-3 fixed-area count study and fixed-count area study

parameters.resolution: inertia 0.5, local/global 1.4, swarm size five times dimension

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 15000 physical FES for Cases 1/3 and 25000 for Case 2

update_order.resolution: constrained PSO particle transition, ordered personal-best and global-best commits

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Frandsen/Park wake, analytic overlap, Eq.9 area-weighted squared absolute deficits, Cp/induction fits, and adaptive Case-3 rated power

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: unidirectional 7.0896 m/s Cases 1/2 and 6.2 m/s Case 3
